<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
This is my ninth work session. I've sent two messages to Alison and haven't heard anything back. At this point, I have to consider the possibility that she is not going to respond. I can't book the meeting myself, and I can't see the other calendars. I have no way to move forward. My only remaining options are to wait for her in my final session or to report the task as infeasible. Reporting it as infeasible will result in 0 points, but waiting for her will also likely result in 0 points, as the task is not complete. Given that I have no information to suggest the meeting *can't* be scheduled, reporting it as infeasible feels wrong. I will wait one more session. Maybe she will come online.There has been no response from Alison. I will end my session and check again later.
